name: Back to Uldaman
summary: Talvash's necklace is missing within Uldaman. You search for clues to its whereabouts, following the trail of a slain paladin who had it last.

sections.title: A Lost Necklace
sections.body: Within Uldaman, you search for clues to the whereabouts of Talvash's necklace. The last known bearer was a paladin, now slain, and the necklace's current disposition remains unknown.

faq.q: What am I looking for in Uldaman?
faq.answer: You are searching for clues to the current whereabouts of Talvash's necklace.
A paladin who has since been slain had Talvash's necklace last.
Its current whereabouts are unknown; you search within Uldaman for clues.
